2610.11216.title: The Lattice of Transition Laws
2610.11216.paper_summary: Diffusion and autoregression (AR) have long been seen as different categories of generative models, with diffusion specialising in continuous fields and AR specialising in discrete tokens. Recent work seeks to combine the advantages of the two models, and each hybrid fixes its decoding schedule by design. In this paper, we ask whether the performance of decoding schedules of one model can be predicted before decoding at a fixed number of steps. We describe diffusion, AR, and models in between as paths on one corruption lattice, and define the cost of a schedule as the dependence its parallel steps discard. The cost shows that the fewest steps of a zero-cost schedule are set by the geometry of the data, in the same way for tokens and for continuous fields. In particular, for data that are Markov on a graph and dependent along its paths, the fewest steps equal the graph's treedepth, which is logarithmic in the length of a sequence and linear in the side length of a grid. With fewer steps than the treedepth, every schedule pays a positive cost, whose ranking we predict before decoding with a kernel of pairwise dependence estimated from pretrained weights. Across text generation, image generation, and video generation, we verify most of the predictions about the rankings of different schedules under different metrics and benchmarks. This work therefore provides a design principle for decoding for future AR models, diffusion models, and anything in between. Our code is available at https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws.
2610.11216.paper_summary_zh: 擴散和自回歸（AR）長期以來被視為生成模型的不同類別，擴散專注於連續場，而AR則專注於離散標記。最近的研究旨在結合這兩種模型的優點，並且每個混合模型都通過設計固定其解碼計劃。在本文中，我們探討一種模型的解碼計劃的性能是否可以在固定步數之前進行預測。我們將擴散、AR及其之間的模型描述為一個腐蝕格上的路徑，並將計劃的成本定義為其平行步驟所丟棄的依賴性。成本顯示，零成本計劃的最少步數由數據的幾何形狀決定，對於標記和連續場的情況相同。特別是，對於在圖上馬爾可夫且沿其路徑相依的數據，最少步數等於圖的樹深度，這在序列長度上是對數級別，在網格的邊長上是線性級別。當步數少於樹深度時，每個計劃都會支付正成本，我們在解碼之前利用從預訓練權重估算的成對依賴核來預測其排名。在文本生成、圖像生成和視頻生成中，我們驗證了關於不同計劃在不同指標和基準下排名的預測。這項工作因此為未來的AR模型、擴散模型及其之間的任何模型提供了一個解碼設計原則。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/TSUITUENYUE/The-Lattice-of-Transition-Laws 獲得。
